name: Vibe Life
tagline: adriiita's editorial house look: cream paper, ink outlines, Space Grotesk claims with one Instrument Serif word in a peach pill.

motion.direction: adriiita `vibe-life`. Cream paper with a faint grid, ink outlines (0.2 cqw) and flat hard shadows, no blur on chrome. Headlines: Space Grotesk 500 sentence case + exactly ONE Instrument Serif italic word per frame, in a peach `ter` or butter `gold` pill — never two accents at full strength. Captions are small serif-italic phrases on the seam between footage and card (`card` mode = stacked split, B-roll top, face bottom). "Paper cuts" of 80–120 ms replace crossfades; the camera pushes 1.0 → 1.12 over 2–3 s. Section turns via a dark `chapterCard`; the emphasis ladder is caption → pill → bar → headline → one glow word.
